$comment: HEAPY Edge upload contract v1: site box -> central HEAPY Trend Tracker server. HTTPS only, outbound from the box. JSON bodies, gzip allowed (Content-Encoding: gzip). The same batch shape is used by every destination (server, local Trend Tracker, file drop).

POST /api/edge/v1/pair.auth: none (one-time pairing code in the body)

body.code: string, one-time code shown in Trend Tracker

reply.key: string, secret for this box only (store it, never log it)

rules: The server must treat a repeated batch_id as already stored (reply ok again, do not duplicate).
The box deletes nothing until it gets ok for that batch_id.
4xx other than 408/429: the box stops and reports the error. 408, 429, 5xx and network errors: retry with backoff.

reply.config: optional object (point selections, intervals, scan windows) when newer than the box's

Batch.seq: integer, increases by one per batch from this box
devices: Device (driver contract) - new or changed since the last batch
points: Point (driver contract) plus { selected, interval_s } - new or changed
